procedure: Rebuild the validation environment using only canonical instructions and frozen inputs.
Re-run schema, coverage, source-path, hash and deterministic runner checks.
Write outputs to a new directory without reading Codex-A outputs before completion.
After completion compare result hashes and normalized reports against Codex-A.
Require byte-identical deterministic scorer outputs and semantically identical validation findings.
oracle_rule: Oracle access is allowed only after environment freeze; this operator becomes ineligible for future held-out resolver execution.
